static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has many friends outside work, worrying about being excluded by colleagues, socializing at work affected
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history, no psychotherapy history, no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to describe Anxiety and bodily sensations (like stomach discomfort), Good cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that after attending the Kings of Leon concert we went to together, colleagues will no longer want to hang out with me. I believe they think I forced them to attend a concert they were not interested in.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these negative thoughts are affecting my social relationships and causing significant distress, so I am seeking counseling; I hope to be more at ease around my colleagues and rejoin their lunches and socializing.

core_beliefs: I will be excluded by coworkers

special_situations.event: After attending a Kings of Leon concert with colleagues (last week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make them do something they are not interested in, they will feel forced by me and distance themselves
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterward avoiding Attending social activities or lunch with colleagues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will no longer want to hang out with me

special_situations.event: During the concert, colleagues cheered and applauded, and afterward someone gave the feedback 'that was a great performance'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others give positive feedback it may just be out of politeness, not reflecting their true feelings
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or doubting positive evidence, Persistent self-doubt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just politely complimenting; they did not actually enjoy it

special_situations.event: Scenarios of socializing with colleagues outside work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If our interests are not aligned, I cannot fit into their circle
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying Withdrawn in Social situations, reducing participation to avoid Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want me around

special_situations.event: When thinking about having different interests from colleagues or recalling concert details
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no solid evidence that they enjoy being with me, it means they do not like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminating on negative possibilities, avoiding further contact to lower Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their positive behavior does not mean they truly enjoy being with me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by colleagues and fit in
defense_goal: Reducing the likelihood of Being rejected and maintaining safety by keeping distance and Avoids socializing

object_relations.self_representation: A person who does not fit in and may be excluded
object_relations.object_representation: Others (colleagues) who would be perfunctory or rejecting

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing after-Work social invitations from colleagues or thinking about having different interests from them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes colleagues are brushing them off and will ultimately reject them (transference: projecting Fear onto colleagues' thoughts)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using an Empathetic and gradually inquiring tone, inviting them to specify evidence and context, gently challenging speculations about 'what they are thinking', while maintaining safety and acceptance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When positive feedback from colleagues appears (such as praising the performance as very good)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think the other person is only being polite, denying the positive meaning in it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Guides them to connect present emotions with body sensations, distinguish facts from assumptions, reduce over-explanation, and use concrete details to check the other person's real feedback.

manifestations: Worrying that differing interests from colleagues make it impossible to fit in
Anticipating Being rejected during after-Work socializing and feeling Anxiety
Avoiding socializing with colleagues out of fear
The possibility of being excluded circles repeatedly in one's mind

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When worrying about Being rejected, not expressing true thoughts and needs, redirecting energy into self-Withdrawal
Avoids joining colleagues' lunches or after-work social activities

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing colleagues were forced by me, did not enjoy it, and will not associate with me again
Replacing factual evidence with speculations like 'they do not want me around'

exception_events.target_problem: When socializing with colleagues outside Work, the client usually Anticipates Being rejected and feels Anxiety, thus Avoiding interaction.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At last week's Kings of Leon concert, the client did not have the usual strong worries, drinking and interacting with colleagues; colleagues cheered and applauded on site and said afterward 'this was a great show', with smooth overall interaction.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situation (live music and shared activity brought positive cues); different support (colleagues' positive behaviors and feedback); noticing positive interactions that evening instead of negative guesses.

positive_force: Colleagues' positive interaction and positive feedback at concerts
The client has self-awareness and is willing to identify and challenge negative thoughts
Has a few friends outside work who can provide some support
Work performance stable, daily functions not yet significantly affected
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases: predicting the future, mind reading, mental filtering, negating the positive
Worries about 'not fitting in' Reinforcing dependence on external acceptance
Avoids socializing due to Fear, causing insufficient evidence and Intensified sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding socializing with colleagues outside Work (not attending lunch or activities)
antecedent: Situations of socializing with colleagues outside work
Thinking about having different interests from colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being unable to fit in and being excluded, influenced by cognitive biases like mind reading, predicting the future, mental filtering, and negating the positive
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible rejection to lower immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged friendships and connections at Work, Increased sense of isolation, Persistent anxiety and physical discomfort

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety and stomach discomfort in social situations
antecedent: Socializes with colleagues outside work or thinks of their opinions
Recalling concerts and worrying about being excluded
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of Being rejected and physiological responses triggered by negative automatic thoughts
target_behavior.function: Alert and Self-protection (briefly reducing discomfort by prompting avoidance)
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening exhaustion and discomfort, further Reduced socializing participation and Reinforcing avoidance patterns
